units: Gitt. VI, 5 אף המ׳ the same applies to one taken sick; Y. ib. 48ᵃ, sq. מ׳ כל שקפץ וכ׳ m’sukkan is he who was suddenly overcome, contrad. to חוֹלֶה.

<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:5">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא סבר מ׳ הוא</he> and he thought his health was endangered (by a delay); <cite ref="Tamid 27b:35">Tam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא מ׳ הוא</he>; a. fr.—Fem. <he>מְסוּכֶּנֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:6">Ḥull. II, 6</cite> <he>השוחט את המ׳</he> he who slaughters a beast which threatens to die.—[<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 22:6">Midr. Prov. ch. XXII</cite> <he>מסוכן בחייו</he>, v. <cite ref="O00921"><he>סָכַן</he> I</cite>].
